message: The other day, I was chatting with my grandson about my old flip phone and how it never seemed to run out of battery. Just as he was about to show me a funny video on his smartphone, it decided to die on him. We both had a good laugh, but it got me thinking about how reliant we are on our devices. It’s a good reminder to have a backup plan, whether it’s a printed list of important contacts or a few essentials packed away. What’s your favorite old-school trick for staying connected?
